row.answer: Jayce is a fighter and marksman who switches between ranged Cannon abilities and melee Hammer abilities. His AD-focused fighting pattern combines physical projectile poke with a leap and close-range attacks, while some Hammer effects deal magic damage.
row.counterplay: Dodge his projectile poke, respect his leap range, and avoid extended close-range trades.
